id_syntax.location: +AAAAAA: the building number (Statsbygg: 6 digits), given by the client
id_syntax.system: =NNN.nnn: system code from Vedlegg 9.1 (three digits) and a running number 001..999
id_syntax.component: -BBnnn: component code from Vedlegg 9.2 (two letters) and a running number (occurrence)
id_syntax.component_type: -BBnnnT: the same with a trailing T: the component type (parallel identification)

running_numbers_electrical: UE/KW: the running number is the circuit (kurs) number
